body:
ops-incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: P1 - Region failover initiated for eu-west1 -> us-central1. Traffic drop detected from eu-edge to eu-west1; automated failover started at 2026-03-15T12:01:40Z. Notifying on-call.

maya: seeing ~45% 5m drop in successful connect rates to eu-west1 workers, proxy 503s. customers without region pinning affected.

raj: confirmed. load balancer health checks failing on 3/6 hosts in eu-west1 (connection timeout). possible fabric-level network flaps.

olivia: are we seeing token generation errors or just connection failures?

maya: connection failures upstream, model containers healthy. KV cache lookups fine.

james: starting mitigation: disabling eu-west1 egress to external partner for testing, ramping traffic to us-central1 pool, enabling degraded-mode routing.

ops-incident-bot: Action taken: set routing policy=failover(us-central1) for customers without strict region pin. Timestamp: 2026-03-15T12:06:03Z.

raj: good. can someone mute the noisy LB healthcheck monitors? they're paging everyone with repeated flaps.

maya: +1, alerts are spamming channel. current alert: datadog monitor 'LB: eu-west1 healthcheck failures' threshold=5 hosts failing for 1m. firing every 1m.

monitoring-team: muting monitor and escalating a separate incident-specific channel. Will adjust to detection window 3m and add runbook link.

james: noting customer impact: ~12% of requests got 503s or were migrated; major customers with region pinning saw degraded latency until failover. opening incident ticket for SLA review.

olivia: on-call handoff in 40m. I'll prepare notes for next shift: root cause suspected network fabric in eu-west1; mitigation was automated failover plus temporary route policy.

raj: post-incident monitoring action items:
- tune LB monitor to require 3m sustained failure and only alert P0s after 5 hosts down for 5m
- create a low-noise 'flap' monitor that notifies but doesn't page unless sustained
- add a Grafana panel for cross-region traffic-shift with per-customer region pinning breakdown

maya: sample Datadog query we'll use for the flap monitor:```query
avg(last_5m):avg:nginx.healthcheck_fail{region:eu-west1} by {host} > 0.8
```
change suggestion: use rolling 5m -> 3m and reduce notify->warning channel for first 2 alerts.

monitoring-team: also propose new synthetic that exercises the control plane failover path every 15m. If synthetic fails, page SRE once per hour after 3 consecutive failures.

james: need a multi-region dashboard URL: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/regional-health?orgId=1. Adding panels:
- traffic by region (p50/p95 latency)
- active connections per region
- failover counts per region
- customer pinning distribution

olivia: added temporary annotation for failover start/end, will add final RCA link once write-up done.

raj: follow-ups for runbook and alerting:
- update runbook section 'region failover' with exact CLI commands used (`rwctl route set --policy failover --to us-central1 --scope global`)
- add playbook step to confirm KMS access in target region before full failover
- craft email template for customers explaining transient errors and mitigation steps

maya: suggestion: add a guard to the automated failover to check control-plane quorum; we almost triggered full failover when only LB tests were failing.

monitoring-team: agreed; will prototype a control-plane quorum check metric and wire it into the routing policy decision (feature flagged).

sre-rota-bot: Reminder: next on-call handoff at 2026-03-15T12:45:00Z -> olivia takes the bridge.

olivia: picking up bridge in 25m. leaving notes: routing policy changed, LB monitors muted and reconfigured, synthetic monitors scheduled, incident ticket #INC-2026-421 opened.

james: raising an alert fatigue postmortem: this incident generated ~120 alert notifications across 8 people. action: create 'noise penalty' metric to cut repeated alerts originating from same root cause.

maya: re: dashboards - add small widgets for 'alerts fired per incident' and 'alerts suppressed' so we can measure improvements after tuning.

monitoring-team: timeline for changes: mute now, config changes in 2 hours, dashboard PR by EOD, runbook updates tomorrow morning. Will tag monitoring owners on the PR.

ops-incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> degraded. Failover completed, traffic stabilized in us-central1. Next steps: RCA, alert tuning, dashboard work, runbook updates.

olivia: leaving final note before handoff: please sync with SRE oncall rotation if any regression. If customers report degraded behavior after traffic reflow, escalate to P1.

james: thanks all. I'll start the RCA draft and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks. closing channel for noise; if you need to re-open incident thread, ping @ops-incident-bot.
